Hi! I'm Ani Shaikova, a student in AD688 Big Data and Cloud Analytics at Boston University.

## PySpark example

```{python}
from pyspark.sql import SparkSession

spark = SparkSession.builder.appName("demo").getOrCreate()
spark.sparkContext.setLogLevel("ERROR")

df = spark.createDataFrame(
    [("Python", 1991), ("Spark", 2014), ("Quarto", 2022)],
    ["tool", "year"]
)
df.show()
spark.stop()
```
